hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro has fled to the United States via Argentina, declaring himself Brazil's 'true president' and alleging widespread election fraud. The escape has sparked intense legal maneuvers in Brazil, with opposition parties demanding his arrest and asset freezes, while triggering diplomatic friction across Latin America and the US.
hotspots.affect: The story commands massive affective investment through narratives of a stolen election, clandestine political escape, severe legal jeopardy, and high-stakes international political asylum drama.

hotspots.title: PiS Internal Crisis Over Kaczyński's Polexit Remarks
hotspots.blurb: PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński sparked a major political storm by suggesting 'hard and risky' negotiations over exiting the European Union if proposed EU reforms fail. The remarks triggered severe internal pushback from former Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki, who warned the party is 'playing with fire,' alongside furious denunciations from opposition leaders.
hotspots.affect: High affective charge stems from existential anxiety over Poland's European status, combined with an explosive public rift at the highest levels of the nation's right-wing opposition.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: As Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella navigate the aftermath of the Rassemblement National congress, the party faces intense media heat over a deadly attack in Yvelines where the perpetrator possessed homemade RN promotional stickers. Simultaneously, Le Pen's legal team is battling court rulings threatening her 2027 eligibility while opponents accuse the party of heightening racial tension.
hotspots.affect: Attention is supercharged by intense moral accusations surrounding far-right violence, high-stakes legal jeopardy regarding presidential eligibility, and aggressive media positioning.

hotspots.title: SD Internal Feud Over Swedish Identity Principles
hotspots.blurb: Sverigedemokraterna party leader Jimmie Åkesson has issued an explicit ultimatum to party members rejecting 'open Swedishness,' ordering ethnic nationalist dissenters like Richard Jomshof to fall in line or leave the party. The public clash has exposed deep ideological fractures over the definition of Swedish identity, raising alarms among political analysts about potential instability across the Swedish right.
hotspots.affect: The controversy commands intense focus due to an aggressive leadership purge threat, explicit ideological warfare over national identity, and fears of a right-wing coalition collapse.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage sparked sharp criticism after skipping the Chancellor's Budget speech, claiming he did so to avoid a physical altercation with Lib Dem MP Caroline Voaden, who publicly denied his account and accused him of bullying. The controversy coincides with damaging headlines regarding a former Farage campaign security guard sentenced to prison for rape.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot generates high heat through parliamentary drama, accusations of physical intimidation, and sensationalized personal scandal surrounding key party figures.
